Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 9, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA

Appointments of Officials to Boards and Commissions (CC/BSD)
1.
Approve the reappointment of Vista representatives to the various outside boards and commissions they served on in 2008, and adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , reappoint-ing Councilmember Campbell as representative and Councilmember Ritter as alternate to the Board of Directors of the North San Diego County Transit Development Board (NCTD);
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , reappoint-ing Councilmember Ritter as representative and Councilmember Campbell and Councilmember Gronke as first and second alternates respectively, to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG);
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , and Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , reappointing Mayor/Chairperson Vance and Councilmember/Director Ritter representatives and Councilmember/Director Campbell and Director of Engineering Larry Pierce alternates to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority; and
